biggest_catch: This is a LOAN referral, not a checking-account referral: you only get the $50 check if your friend or family member actually gets a loan from Citizens Savings & Loan ('we are able to help with a loan'). Referring someone who only inquires or is declined earns you nothing.
catches: Payout is triggered only when Citizens Savings & Loan is 'able to help' the referred person with a loan — i.e., the friend must apply for and receive a loan, subject to the bank's lending criteria and approval.
Referrer must put their name on the referral form/card so the bank knows where to send the $50 check.
The bank's page does not state a referral cap, payout timing, or tax treatment — all unstated, so treat per-referral payout timing as unknown.
The friend must be someone genuinely seeking a loan; the program is presented as a friends-and-family loan referral (personal loans and other loan types the bank offers).

eligibility: Anyone who can hand a referral card/form to a friend or family member; no account or membership requirement is stated on the program page. The referred person must qualify for and receive a loan from Citizens Savings & Loan.

steps: Pick up referral cards at a Citizens Savings & Loan branch or print the referral form from the program page.
Write your name on the referral form/card so the bank knows where to send the $50.
Give the form/card to a friend or family member who is interested in a loan.
Your friend applies for and receives a loan from Citizens Savings & Loan.
The bank sends you a $50 check.
timing: Payout timing not stated on the program page; the bank mails a $50 check once the referred person has been helped with a loan.
when_cash_arrives: Payout timing not stated on the program page; the bank mails a $50 check once the referred person has been helped with a loan. Paid only when your friend's loan is approved, closed, and funded.
maximize: Pre-qualify your friend (credit score, income docs, loan purpose) before the formal application so underwriting does not stall.
Refer people already shopping for that exact loan type (auto, personal) - cold referrals rarely convert to funded loans.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: application to underwriting to funding is a multi-week pipeline you cannot accelerate - loan referrals are the slowest conversion type.
